summary: Derived the universal founding bridge from four typed premises over an agency vocabulary (attestation by the resurrection, divine veracity applied to confirmation, the mandate's scope over Jesus' founding with a teaching commission, envoy founding, restricted to Jesus as envoy). The society-universal is carried by the scope premise, not derived. Omission models show each premise necessary; a joint model shows the premises and every stage antecedent satisfiable. Newly pinned Acts 17 and John 13; the attestation premise is read from Acts 17.31, Matthew 28.18-20, John 13.20 and Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 1 support the other three. All four premises remain open; the scope premise's universal reach over societies and the eleven-to-society map are unsourced. The bare bridge leaves the frontier; route costs rise by 3. Not established: the bridge's truth, any premise, or historical fidelity.
